guide.title: How to Use
guide.subtitle: A simple guide to getting the most out of AI Message Assistant

s1.title: Set Up Your API Key
s1.desc: Click the Settings icon in the navigation bar and enter your Gemini API key. You can get one for free from aistudio.google.com.

s2.title: Paste Your Message
s2.desc: Go to the Analyze page and paste the message or conversation you received. Choose between single message or full conversation mode.

s3.title: Analyze the Message
s3.desc: Click 'Analyze Message' and wait for the AI to process. It will classify the message type, priority, sentiment, and determine if a reply is needed.

s4.title: Review the Results
s4.desc: Read the analysis including message classification, priority level, and the reasoning behind the AI's decision.

s5.title: Use the Suggested Reply
s5.desc: If a reply is needed, review the suggested reply. You can copy it, edit it, translate it, or restyle it in different tones.

s6.title: Restyle if Needed
s6.desc: Use the restyle feature to change the tone — choose from professional, friendly, formal, technical, and more.

tips.title: Pro Tips
tips.t1: Use the 'Clean Up Text' button to fix messy or poorly formatted messages before analyzing.
tips.t2: Use 'Full Conversation' mode when context from previous messages matters.
tips.t3: Translate messages to Arabic to better understand them before replying.
tips.t4: Check your analysis history to reuse or reference previous replies.
tips.t5: Always review suggested replies for sensitive messages — the AI flag will warn you.

rules.title: Rules & Terms
rules.subtitle: Please read and understand these terms before using AI Message Assistant

usage.title: How It Works
items: You paste a message or conversation into the analysis tool
The AI analyzes the content, tone, and intent of the message
The system classifies the message and suggests an appropriate reply
You can edit, restyle, or translate the suggested reply before using it

allowed.title: Allowed Use
items: Analyzing personal messages to understand tone and intent
Getting reply suggestions for professional communication
Translating messages between English and Arabic
Using the tool for learning and improving communication skills

notAllowed.title: Not Allowed
items: Using the tool for spam, harassment, or harmful communication
Sharing your API key with others
Using generated replies in illegal or unethical contexts
Automated bulk processing of messages without human oversight

items: You are responsible for all messages you input into the system

Keep your API key secure and do not share it
Use the tool ethically and responsibly

about.title: About AI Message Assistant
about.subtitle: Learn more about this tool, its purpose, and the developer behind it

what.title: What is AI Message Assistant?
what.desc: AI Message Assistant is a smart web tool designed to help you understand incoming messages — especially from Discord and other English text sources — and craft professional, context-appropriate replies. It uses advanced AI to analyze message tone, intent, priority, and suggest the best possible response.

why.title: Why Was It Built?
why.desc: Communication in English can be challenging, especially when messages require precise, professional responses. This tool was built to bridge that gap — helping users understand messages clearly and respond confidently with the right tone and content.

how.title: How Does It Work?
how.desc: The system uses Google's Gemini AI with deep thinking to analyze messages through multiple layers — understanding language, detecting sentiment, classifying message type, and generating contextually appropriate replies. It supports multiple reply tones and translation between English and Arabic.

developer.title: Meet the Developer
developer.name: Ali
developer.bio: Ali is a passionate software developer specializing in building intelligent web applications powered by AI. With a focus on creating practical tools that solve real communication challenges, Ali designed AI Message Assistant to help users navigate English conversations with confidence and professionalism.
developer.visionDesc: To empower users with AI-driven tools that make professional communication effortless — bridging language gaps and ensuring every response is thoughtful, accurate, and contextually appropriate.
